acceptance: The aggregate gate depends on every required job and fails on skipped, absent or failed jobs; vulnerability scanners are pinned, bounded and report unavailable as inconclusive.

positive.fixture: gate passes only when every job succeeded; scan covers every locked package

negative.fixture: skipped, absent or failed jobs; network failure and empty queries are unavailable, never clean

security_and_source_permissions: Scanner failure is inconclusive; ignores expire; the failure canary is unchanged.
known_limitations: Scan depends on osv.dev availability and reports unavailable otherwise
